observed_before: Held movement 127 with target/eased 1.000 and actual 0.050 on repeated live samples.
cause: Loopback SYSTEMINFO applies delayed timescale values to shared server/client cvar, feeding stale state back into authoritative clock.
fix: Ignore timescale echo only for active local server + loopback client; preserve remote updates. Controller detects lost actual value and recovers within publish budget.
observed_after: Repeated live held-input samples show target/eased/actual 1.000. Build, echo guard, timebind and fractional clock tests pass.
prediction: Eliminates observed held-key sticking caused by clock echoes; other gameplay modifiers still intentionally slow time.
